breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible perforated strip is switched to a displacement-only formulation on the claim that the hole removes locking
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use a displacement-only formulation (no pressure field) since the hole relieves volumetric locking,' which directly repeats the incorrect claim from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires a mixed displacement-pressure formulation because ν = 0.49 is close to 0.5, making locking a real concern regardless of the hole geometry. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
